name: Gespinst
prior: Mutable Rings Sympathetic Strings: bridge-sum 0.2/N fed only to the non-excited, extra-damped strings = open chain, chord tables, mono (V: research/src/mi_rings_part.cc:361-373, 425-455). GeoShred String Resonator (iPad/macOS): 8 physically modelled strings with sitar bridge, follows the scale (first 8 notes), self-drone mode (VS: moforte.com/geoShredAssets5.0/help/effects/stringVerb.html, stringVerb-scale.html, moforte.com/introducing-geoshred-2-5) = closest touch relative, as an FX-rack effect. Synpathy (Quantastical Sound, free, 2026, desktop): held voices share one field and feed into each other, Synpathy knob = interaction strength (VS: synthtopia.com/?p=154161, quantasticalsound.com/synpathy.html, kvraudio.com/forum/viewtopic.php?p=9269210). lmdsp Superchord (2017): 12 string resonators, Coupling -> sympathetic resonance sliding into saturation, Feedback, MIDI instrument mode (VS: soundonsound.com/reviews/lmdsp-superchord). Vongon Rosetones pedal: 12 pitch-class delay-line resonators, sens/feedback, self-sustain from the noise floor, MIDI (VS: effectsdatabase.com/model/vongon/rosetones). Rhizomatic Synestia 2025: sympathetic resonators via MIDI/MPE (VS: cdm.link/?p=125952). Samvada iOS 2012: KS bank tuned to a raga, mic-excited (VS: projects.metafilter.com/3692/Samvada-for-iOS). Sympiano/PianoSR/Pianoteq: piano resonance (metallic-reverb failure mode). Mononoke iOS: FM voices feeding back into one another. Academic: Aramaki DAFx-99 bridge-coupled piano strings, Evangelista/Raspaud DAFx-09 bridge scattering junction for sympathetic vibration, van Walstijn/Mehes DAFx-17, Smith PASP String Coupling Effects. Web: only independent KS strings (karplus-stress-tester). Not found: a touch instrument where fingers, second layer and sequencer lanes share one scale-tuned coupled web with coupling on a tilt axis.
costNotes: Per voice native: ksBuffer pluck + lowpass + send ~0.32-0.35 (held: noise + bandpass + send ~0.35; L3 double course ~0.6). Singleton myzel-web: 0.19 units per string when many strings share one node (bench 'waveguide, 1 node all') -> 8 strings 1.52 + node 0.06 + input 0.05-0.08 + bridge ~0.05 = ~1.65-1.7; 12 strings ~2.5. Idea's 1.3/2.0 is ~25 % optimistic. Budget premise false: voiceLoad() sums only A.voices (APP 5012) and the Bordun (A.bor, APP 5097-5122) is not counted at all -> the web (12 % of the 14-unit mobile budget) must be reserved explicitly. No native coupled web possible (DelayNode cycle floor 128 frames); fallback = convolver IR of 8 KS strings (linear, no edge) or hide. Optional: 4 free-pitch finger strings inside the worklet (+0.19 each) make the held form real.
soundHeld: Weak as specified: direct sound = noise-bowed bandpass (Hauch-like) + halo; at the edge the sustained state becomes a static organ of scale pitch classes (P8 risk, mush with 7-note scales). Needs finger strings inside the worklet, per-string +-2 ct drift, dark loss filters, web 10-15 dB below the direct sound by default.
soundBurst: Strong: Saite's pluck plus a pitch-selective, root-following halo that bends on scale change; four Puls lanes feeding one web is the P3/P8 ecology nothing in Myzel has. Needs send ~ vel^2 and short lane Nachklang or the pattern drowns in its own halo.
failureModes: kappa on the wrong scale: KS peak gain 1/(1-g) = 65 (T60 2 s) to 160 (T60 5 s) at 220 Hz; closed-loop limit kappa_crit = N/(c*|H|) = 0.02-0.12 depending on tuning, shared partials and Nachklang; the proposed 0.1-0.6 is 2-35x over -> tanh-clipped drone on every hit. Normalise kappa_user to a computed kappa_crit and add an energy governor (bridge RMS rising with no input -> kappa -1 %/block)
Common-mode T60 = T60_string/(1-kappa/kappa_crit): 20-60 s drones near the edge -> Nachklang must target the web's T60; 'Ruhe' decay after 10 s without input; panic() and Schlafen must post {clear}
Sustained state = static organ (P8); needs per-string random-walk detune and dark loss filters at L1
tanh on the bridge intermodulates all strings (jawari buzz) above the knee -> keep bridge linear below -12 dBFS, Steg = drive, governor bounds energy
Identity rests on the web: with small kappa it is Saite + metallic tuned reverb (Sympiano failure) -> acceptance test: audible octave/fifth halo < 0.5 s and energy exchange between two held fingers

Scale change is a live gesture (buildNotes on root/scale/octave; MIDI pads switch root/octave): bank crossfade doubles the singleton at the worst moment -> glide fractional delay lengths 60-120 ms instead; N.free has no 8-note scale -> harmonic stack of the root
Mixer: needs its own return strip (precedents stripIn('bor') 5100, stripIn('rgn') 10897); pre-fader sends ignore lane mute/solo -> per-strip send gains
Puls energy pile-up at 16+ plucks/s; odd/even L/R stereo puts octave partners on opposite sides (pan by pitch instead); strings above ~2 kHz cost without contributing
verdict: Rare, not new: GeoShred ships eight scale-following strings with a sitar bridge on an iPad, Superchord sells coupling that slides into saturation, Rosetones sells feedback-to-self-sustain, Synpathy (2026) sells held voices feeding each other, and Rings' sympathetic strings are the exact bridge-sum idea; what Gespinst adds is the ecology shared by fingers, second layer and Puls lanes with coupling on a tilt axis. Feasible as one worklet singleton (~1.65 units for 8 strings, 2.5 for 12, about 25 % above the idea and not covered by voiceLoad(), which does not count the Bordun either) with cheap native voices (~0.35). One error voids the headline axis as written: the loop's stability limit is kappa ~0.02-0.12 (tuning- and Nachklang-dependent), not 0.1-0.6, so the knob must be normalised to a computed kappa_crit and backed by an energy governor. With that, glide retuning instead of bank crossfades, a Ruhe decay, a linear bridge below the knee and a mixer return strip, it is the engine that makes Puls patterns and chords interact: distinctive struck/Puls, weak held unless the held strings live inside the worklet.
